intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: In the beginning, there was only Memory. And Memory was the world.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: But Memory is fragile. It fractures. It fades. And when Memory breaks... the world breaks with it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: You are a Memory Walker. One of the few who can navigate the fragments. Find the pieces. Reconstruct the truth.

keeper.speaker: keeper
keeper.text: Another walker arrives. How many have come before? I have lost count.

keeper.speaker: keeper
keeper.text: You seek the Primordial Memory. The first memory. The memory that started it all.

keeper.speaker: keeper
keeper.text: But know this: to reconstruct the world, you must first deconstruct yourself. Are you willing to be forgotten... so that others may remember?

keeper.speaker: keeper
keeper.text: Memory is not a thing you keep. It is a thing you give. Every memory shared doubles. Every memory hoarded withers.

keeper.speaker: keeper
keeper.text: Then create anew. Not as it was. As it *could be*.

scavenger.speaker: scavenger
scavenger.text: Shiny... shiny memories... mine... all mine...

scavenger.speaker: scavenger
scavenger.text: Don't take them! I found them first! They're mine to forget!

guardian.speaker: guardian
guardian.text: Halt. The ruins are sealed. No walker may pass without the Key.

guardian.speaker: guardian
guardian.text: My memory... returning... I remember... I was built to protect... not destroy...

spirit.speaker: spirit
spirit.text: The forest remembers what you have forgotten. Leave, walker. Your kind brings only sorrow.

spirit.speaker: spirit
spirit.text: Perhaps... not all walkers are the same. The forest will watch your path.

forgotten.speaker: forgotten
forgotten.text: REMEMBER US. REMEMBER US. REMEMBER US.

forgotten.speaker: forgotten
forgotten.text: You carry so many memories... but do you carry *ours*?

forgotten.speaker: forgotten
forgotten.text: To be forgotten is to never have existed. We refuse. WE REFUSE.

forgotten.speaker: forgotten
forgotten.text: If you will not remember... then we will MAKE you remember. FOREVER.

environmental.text: Day 847. The fractures spread. We tried to bind memory into stone, but stone forgets too.
Drink deep, walker. The water remembers what the stone forgets.
The trees grow in rings. Each ring a year. Each year a memory. We are the rings.
Crystals grow in perfect geometry. Memory grows in chaos. Yet both are true.
Look into the water. See not your face. See your choices. See what you forgot.
Here lies the memory of a first kiss. Here lies the memory of a last breath. Here lies... nothing.
Place the fragments. Speak the words. The world remembers through you.

itemPickup.text: A fragment returns. The world sharpens slightly.
A core memory! The world shifts. New paths open.
THE PRIMORDIAL MEMORY. The beginning. The end. The choice.
New ability unlocked. Memory reshapes capability.

levelUp.text: Ten levels. A milestone. Keen Insight awakens.
Quarter century of growth. The world takes notice.
Maximum potential reached. But memory has no maximum.

death.text: You fall. The fragments scatter. But memory persists.
Death is not the end. It is a comma in the sentence of your journey.
The Forgotten claim another. But you... you always return.

bossDefeat.text: The Guardian falls. Its memory joins yours. The ruins breathe easier.
The Spirit returns to the forest. The trees sing a new song.
The Colossus shatters. Prismatic light scatters. A path opens.
The Prism converges. One light from many. The gardens are whole.
The Forgotten are remembered at last. They fade into peace. The Void trembles.
The Keeper bows. 'The world is yours to shape.' The altar glows.
